title: Opening a Hell Gate

sources.title: Devil's Fee
markers: After placing all five items on correct places

summary: Helsik’s diagram gives the five placements that open the portal to the House of Hope.

fields.Ritual: Place the skull on the point nearest the altar. Move clockwise to place the Coin of Mammon on the next point, skip one, then place the diamond, then the incense. Put Infernal Marble in the centre. The completed circle opens the House of Hope portal.
fields.Acquisition: Helsik supplies the note, grimoire, and components when she agrees to help.

changes: Added native BG3 mechanics or quest use from pinned sources.
